presets.description: Near-maximum lengths: four participants with long labels, five turns, two exhibits, long scenario labels and captions, two shared facts and long comparison labels.
presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (AUTHORING item 20). TRUE DRIVER: at 1:1 two complete rooms share the frame with ONE panel listing four 45–49 character participants, five turns (the contrasted one twice), two exhibits, two shared facts (58 and 43 characters), a 128-character changed fact and long comparison labels; the panel no longer fits beside or under the rooms. Tried before capping (text 22.5 down to 16.4 px at every ratio): text column and bands of 2–4 columns, room width searched with narrower card wrapping, room scales, table beside or below the witness box, label/badge orders. Rendered BEFORE (hold, 1080p): 16:9 16.4 px / people 72.0 px; 9:16 16.4 / 70.9; 1:1 16.4 / 51.9 with panel-overflow. AFTER the cap (participant labels 35–37 characters, one shared fact of 61, changed fact of 82; turns, scenarios and comparison labels unchanged): 16:9 18.0 / 70.1; 9:16 17.1 / 74.7; 1:1 16.4 / 51.5 (1:1 stress floor 45 px); no problems. Every capped field stays longer than its baseline. Pre-cap preset: production/scratch/hearings-03/LAW-0291.presets.precap.json.
